Impact of Cancer on Nutrition and Hematologic Function 
Advanced age is a risk factor for nutritional deficiency; the addition of chronic diseases, including malignancy, can 
quickly lead to malnourishment. These comorbidities can contribute to reduced tolerance of anticancer therapy, 
impacting survival (Stauder et al., 2020).
